prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1160; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not put my name on it yet, if that's okay. Can you just refer to me as the claimant?

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was heading through on the main road when a car coming from the side street pulled out in front of me.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what did you see just before the impact?

A: I was going straight through with a green light, I'm pretty sure. The other vehicle came from my right, and I only had a second to react. I braked and turned the wheel, but they hit my driver's side door.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbags deployed, and the door caved in toward me.

Q: Did you lose consciousness or hit your head?

A: No, I stayed awake the whole time. My head didn't hit anything, but my left arm got slammed against the door frame and the steering wheel.

Q: Where did you receive medical treatment?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed my left wrist and said it was fractured. I've got a cast now and I'm going back to an orthopedic doctor next week.

Q: Has anyone else been involved or made statements about the accident?

A: The other driver said they didn't see me coming. There was a passenger in their car, but I'm not sure what they saw.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: Only that I'm having trouble doing everyday tasks with my dominant hand, and I'm worried about missing work. I'd like to know what the next steps are.
